Messages.Author: Mark Lamutt
Messages.Body:
These came up last night in our group:

1. Can multiple blood dolls be played on the same vampire?

2. Can Rotschrek be played on a vampire trying to play a Rutor's Hand?
We said no because there was no combat involved, and Rot says combat ends
before damage is resolved. Correct?

3. Can master discipline cards (celerity, potence, etc) be played on another
player's vamps? The cards say "Play on a vampire", not play on one of your
vampires.

Thanks,
Mark

Messages.Author: Lupus Australis
Messages.Body:
On 21 Nov 1998, Mark Lamutt wrote:

> These came up last night in our group:
>
> 1. Can multiple blood dolls be played on the same vampire?

Yes, and to cumulative effect. With 2 blood dolls, you can take up to 2
blood on or off during your master phase.

> 2. Can Rotschrek be played on a vampire trying to play a Rutor's Hand?

> We said no because there was no combat involved, and Rot says combat ends
> before damage is resolved. Correct?

Gosh, I'm not sure of that one. I'll pass. I'd say no, because the first
sentence strongly implies that two minions must be involved, and the
remaining context confirms this by assuming a combat situation. Also, it
is questional if he is really "trying" to inflict Ag damage on himself,
since this is just an unwanted side effect of what he is trying to do.

In case you were not aware, Rotshreck effects the target of Ag Damage, not
the person attempting to inflict it. Rotschreck is the self-preservation
instinct of vampires that sends them to torpor when faced with something
that could destroy them.

> 3. Can master discipline cards (celerity, potence, etc) be played on another
> player's vamps? The cards say "Play on a vampire", not play on one of your
> vampires.

Yes.

Lupus Australis

Messages.Body:
mar...@dnvr.uswest.net (Mark Lamutt) wrote:
> These came up last night in our group:
>
> 1. Can multiple blood dolls be played on the same vampire?

Yep. They're cumulative. You can take 2 blood off, for example.

> 2. Can Rotschrek be played on a vampire trying to play a Rutor's Hand?
> We said no because there was no combat involved, and Rot says combat ends
> before damage is resolved. Correct?

*laughs* Oh my, that _would_ be funny. The look on the guy's face alone...
But you are correct.

> 3. Can master discipline cards (celerity, potence, etc) be played on another
> player's vamps? The cards say "Play on a vampire", not play on one of your
> vampires.

Yep. I have a Setite voting deck that steals other people's titled vampires
to help me pass votes. If they don't already have Presence, I give it to
them.

I used to have a Setite deck that stole other vampires, put Protean on them
and used them to bleed with Return to Innocence and Hideous Countenance.
(I didn't have many Day Ops.) I tore it apart a long time ago because it was
much too rude for a social game.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Lupus Australis <jbwh...@dorsai.org> wrote:

> Mark Lamutt wrote:
> > 1. Can multiple blood dolls be played on the same vampire?
>

> Yes, and to cumulative effect. With 2 blood dolls, you can take up to 2
> blood on or off during your master phase.

Correct.

> > 2. Can Rotschrek be played on a vampire trying to play a Rutor's Hand?
>
> > We said no because there was no combat involved, and Rot says combat ends
> > before damage is resolved. Correct?

Right; Rotschreck only applies to a minion's attempt to use agg damage
against his opponent in combat.

> > 3. Can master discipline cards (celerity, potence, etc) be played on
another
> > player's vamps? The cards say "Play on a vampire", not play on one of your
> > vampires.
>

> Yes.

Correct (but not on uncontrolled vampires, of course).
